cast: Lily (girl, 9) and her puppy Max appear in every sentence set.

words.sz: Max 是一只快乐的动物。
words.scene: A happy little group of friendly animals standing together on grass: a puppy, a cat, a rabbit and a cow.
more: A cow is a big animal.

words.en: The big brown bear is sleeping.
words.sz: 那只棕色的大熊在睡觉。
words.note: Word Atlas 的 bear 是动词“忍受”，插画不可用
words.scene: A big friendly brown bear curled up asleep at the mouth of a cave in a pine forest, eyes closed.
more: A bear lives in the forest.
The baby bear is eating honey.

words.en: A bee is on the flower.
words.scene: One fuzzy yellow and black striped honey bee with clear wings sitting on a big pink flower.
more: Look! A bee is flying near the flowers.
看！一只蜜蜂在花旁边飞。

words.sz: Lily 发现了一只黑色的甲虫。
words.scene: Lily crouching and looking with wonder at one shiny black beetle on a leaf in the garden.
more: A beetle is a small black insect.
甲虫是一种黑色的小昆虫。

words.scene: One small round blue bird singing on a branch, beak open, little music notes floating up.
more: There is a bird in the tree.

words.scene: One beautiful butterfly with big open orange and blue patterned wings flying over flowers.
more: 这只蝴蝶有蓝色的翅膀。
A butterfly is sitting on the flower.

words.en: A camel lives in the desert.
words.scene: A single camel with one hump walking across golden sand dunes in the desert, low sun.
more: A camel can walk for a long time without water.
骆驼不喝水也能走很久。
Lily rides a camel on holiday.

words.scene: One fluffy ginger cat with green eyes sitting neatly, its long tail curled around its paws.
more: The cat is sleeping on the bed.

words.en: The chicken has a red head.
words.scene: One plump brown hen with a bright red comb standing on straw in a farmyard.
more: The chicken lives on a farm.

words.en: We get milk from a cow.
words.sz: 我们从奶牛那里得到牛奶。
words.scene: One black and white dairy cow with a pink nose standing in a green meadow, a metal milk pail beside her.
more: A cow is black and white.

words.scene: One green crocodile at a river bank with its long mouth wide open showing big white teeth.
more: A crocodile lives in the river.

words.scene: One friendly green long-necked dinosaur standing among ferns and a small volcano far behind.
more: We see a big dinosaur at the museum.
我们在博物馆看到一只大恐龙。

words.scene: Max the dog standing proudly on grass, wagging his tail.
more: The dog is playing with a ball.
Lily takes her dog to the park.

words.scene: One grey dolphin leaping high out of blue sea waves with splashing water drops.
more: A dolphin is a clever animal.
海豚是一种聪明的动物。
The dolphin swims in the sea.

words.en: A duck is swimming in the lake.
words.scene: One brown mallard duck with a shiny green head, a short flat yellow bill and orange webbed feet, swimming on a small pond with two fluffy yellow ducklings behind it.
more: The duck is swimming with its babies.
We give bread to the duck.

words.en: The elephant has a long nose.
words.scene: One grey elephant with big ears lifting its long trunk high in the air.
more: An elephant is very big and grey.
The elephant drinks water with its nose.

words.scene: One bright orange fish with flowing fins swimming in clear blue water with bubbles.
more: A fish can swim but it can't walk.

words.scene: One bright green frog jumping off a lily pad, legs stretched out, water splashing.
more: The frog lives near the water.
A frog is small and green.

words.scene: One very tall giraffe with a long neck eating leaves from the top of a tree.
more: A giraffe has a very long neck.
The giraffe eats leaves from the tree.

words.scene: One white goat with small horns and a little beard eating grass on a rocky hill.
more: The goat lives on the farm.

words.scene: Lily riding a brown horse, wearing a riding helmet, in a green field.
more: The horse can run very fast.
A brown horse is in the field.
田野里有一匹棕色的马。

words.scene: A few small insects on a big green leaf: a red ant, a ladybird and a green grasshopper.
more: Lily finds a small insect in the garden.
Lily 在花园里发现一只小昆虫。

words.scene: One kangaroo standing in the Australian outback with a baby joey peeking out of her pouch.
more: A kangaroo can jump very high.

words.en: The kitten is playing with Max.
words.scene: A tiny fluffy grey kitten playfully batting at a ball of yarn next to a friendly brown-and-white puppy, cosy living room.
more: A kitten is a baby cat.
The kitten is sleeping in a box.

words.scene: One strong lion with a big golden mane standing proudly on a rock.
more: The lion is the king of the animals.
A lion has a big brown head of hair.
狮子有一头浓密的棕色鬃毛。

words.scene: One brown monkey hanging from a tree branch by its tail, holding a yellow banana.
more: The monkey is climbing the tree.
A monkey has a long tail.

words.en: A little mouse is under the bed.
words.scene: One little grey mouse with big round ears and a long thin tail peeking out from under a bed.
One colourful red, yellow and blue parrot perched on a wooden stand with its beak open as if talking.
more: My parrot is red, blue and yellow.
我的鹦鹉是红色、蓝色和黄色的。
The parrot is sitting on Lily's arm.
鹦鹉停在 Lily 的胳膊上。

words.en: A penguin can swim but can't fly.
words.scene: One black and white penguin standing on ice next to the sea, flippers out.
more: A penguin is black and white.
The penguin lives in a cold place.

words.sz: Max 是 Lily 的宠物。
words.scene: Lily sitting on the sofa at home cuddling Max, a dog bed and a ball on the floor.
more: A rabbit is a good pet.

words.scene: A white polar bear standing on blue-white sea ice under a pale sky, icy water around.
more: A polar bear lives on the ice.
The polar bear is swimming in the cold sea.
北极熊在冰冷的海里游泳。

words.en: Max was a very small puppy.
words.sz: Max 以前是一只很小的小狗。
words.scene: Max as a tiny baby puppy curled up sleeping in a small wicker basket with a blanket.
more: A puppy is a baby dog.

words.scene: One white rabbit with very long upright ears sitting on grass.

words.en: The shark lives in the sea.
words.scene: One grey shark with a pointed fin swimming in the deep blue sea.

words.en: The sheep is white and soft.
words.scene: One round fluffy white sheep with a black face standing in a green field.
more: The sheep is eating grass on the hill.
We get wool from a sheep.
我们从绵羊身上得到羊毛。

words.en: The snake is long and green.
words.scene: One long green snake curled in loops on the ground, its tongue flicking out.
more: The snake is sleeping in the sun.

words.scene: One black spider with eight long legs in the middle of a round spider web.
more: The spider is making a web.
Lily is not afraid of the spider.

words.scene: One elegant white swan with a very long gracefully curved S-shaped neck, an orange and black beak and wings softly raised, gliding on a calm lake with reeds.
more: A swan has a long neck.
The swan is swimming on the lake.

words.scene: Max seen from behind, wagging his fluffy tail, little motion lines around the tail.
more: The monkey holds the tree with its tail.
A happy dog moves its tail.

words.en: The tiger is orange and black.
words.scene: One orange tiger with bold black stripes walking through tall green grass.
more: A tiger is a big cat.
The tiger is sleeping under the tree.

words.scene: One tortoise with a big domed brown shell walking slowly on a path.
more: A tortoise can live for a hundred years.

words.scene: One huge blue whale swimming in the ocean, spouting a fountain of water from its back, a tiny boat far away for size.
more: A whale lives in the sea.
The whale is bigger than a boat.

words.scene: A lion running free across wide golden savanna grassland, acacia trees, no fences.
more: A tiger is a wild animal.
Wild horses live on the hills.

words.en: We see wildlife in the forest.
words.sz: 我们在森林里看到野生动物。
words.scene: A peaceful forest scene full of wild animals: a deer, a fox, an owl on a branch and a squirrel.
more: There is a lot of wildlife in the park.
公园里有很多野生动物。
Lily 喜欢观察野生动物。

words.scene: Close-up of one bird with one big wing stretched wide open, every feather clearly visible.
more: The butterfly has a big wing.
这只蝴蝶有一只大翅膀。
A bird can't fly with a broken wing.

words.en: A zebra is black and white.
words.scene: One zebra with bold black and white stripes standing on the savanna.
more: A zebra looks like a horse.

words.en: Lily and Dad go to the zoo.
words.scene: Lily and Dad walking hand in hand through a cheerful zoo entrance archway decorated with carved animal shapes and no sign, a giraffe and an elephant visible behind the fence.
more: We see lions at the zoo.
The zoo opens at nine o'clock.
